name: Coefficient-Space Maps for Specified PC-Minors
statement: Every specified nonempty pc-minor induces a continuous coefficient-space map by restricting and normalizing chosen representative rows. Its homotopy class is independent of those choices, and composition of specified minors agrees up to homotopy.
proof: A target missing pattern extends with the fixed coordinates and contains an original minimal missing representative. Fixed-coordinate terms are unfavorable, so deleting them preserves strict separation. Straight interpolation compares representative choices.
